edges.description: The terminal hematologic state is the corresponding clinical phenotype.

Tremor is part of the movement phenotype in some allelic presentations.

Neuromuscular weakness can involve the diaphragm and respiratory musculature.

nodes.description: Biallelic pathogenic TPI1 variants impair the steady-state function of triosephosphate isomerase through variant-specific combinations of altered catalysis, dimer formation, thermal stability, and protein turnover. The common p.Glu105Asp variant is structurally destabilizing even though purified mutant enzyme can retain normal catalytic activity; reduced enzyme activity alone is therefore not treated as the complete disease mechanism.
